title: The Teachings of Christ
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The teachings of Christ are His authoritative words revealing God’s kingdom, truth, repentance, righteousness, discipleship, judgment, mercy, and eternal life. Jesus teaches as Lord, not as one opinion among many.
summary: The teachings of Christ are His authoritative words revealing God’s kingdom, truth, repentance, righteousness, discipleship, judgment, mercy, and eternal life. Jesus teaches as Lord, not as one opinion among many.
christFocus: Jesus is the Teacher who reveals the Father and speaks the words of eternal life. His teaching calls sinners to come to Him, trust Him, obey Him, and build their lives on His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus taught with authority unlike the scribes. His words were not speculation or borrowed religious opinion. He spoke as the Son who knows the Father and reveals truth.

His teaching centered on the kingdom of God, repentance, faith, righteousness, mercy, prayer, judgment, discipleship, and life in Him. He exposed hypocrisy and comforted the humble.

Jesus’ teaching must not be separated from His person and work. He is not merely a source of moral sayings; He is the Lord whose words lead to eternal life and obedience.

The risen Christ commands His church to teach disciples to observe all that He commanded. Christian discipleship is therefore shaped by the teaching of Jesus, not by human preference.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many admire selected sayings of Jesus while ignoring His authority, His warnings, His call to repentance, and His claim on the whole life. This produces a partial and powerless view of Christ.

This doctrine reminds believers that following Jesus means hearing and obeying Him. His words are not decorations for faith; they are the teaching of the Lord who saves and rules.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Listen to the teachings of Christ as the words of your Lord. Do not select only the sayings that comfort you while rejecting what confronts you. Build your life, ministry, relationships, and obedience on what Jesus has spoken.
